title: Phone Accessories Franchise Opportunity
tagline: M7 Collections is a UAE-born retail brand specializing in exclusive, trend-driven phone cases and mobile accessories, with over 8 years of operating experience. - The brand has grown from an online business into an omnichannel concept with a physical retail presence in the UAE and worldwide delivery. - The business has built an engaged digital community with 104,000+ Instagram followers, 17,000+ TikTok followers, millions of organic content views, and more than 10,000 fulfilled customer orders. - M7 Collections combines social-media-driven demand with flexible retail formats, including mall kiosks, pop-up stores, and compact retail units. - The brand launches new designs and collections frequently, enabling it to respond to current trends and local customer preferences. - Its key strengths include exclusive product designs, strong organic social media reach, continuous product development, an established brand identity, and a retail format requiring relatively limited space. - The retail store receives an average of more than 30 customer walk-ins per day, providing regular in-store customer traffic. - Franchise partners receive access to the M7 Collections brand and retail concept, opening inventory, branded packaging, product supply, exclusive and regularly updated designs, marketing materials, social media content, product photography, store and kiosk guidelines, and launch support. - The business is currently seeking qualified franchise and territory partners across the GCC, Europe, and selected international markets to introduce and develop M7 Collections in their local markets. - Franchise partners can generate strong revenue and EBITDA by selecting high-footfall retail locations, maintaining an attractive and frequently updated product range, and actively leveraging local social media and marketing channels. The compact retail format, trend-driven products, and regular introduction of new designs provide opportunities to drive repeat purchases and customer engagement.
